title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What have you heard about the upcoming plans? Any details would be helpful, off-record. I gotta put together a “FAQ” for the fans on how this is going to go
I’m still waiting, I believe Spring will be in Detroit as Florida is having virus problems. I don’t know much, just what I’ve read
OK. Yeah, we had a couple TV people say it was in Florida, which surprised me
